verdict.rationale: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at mcp.sumup.com that lets MCP clients and AI assistants manage the account, create checkouts, and process payments. It also offers an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and MCP, so natural-language operation works through a third-party assistant or a custom agent. This is partial because it relies on external tools rather than a first-party natural-language interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of the full set of operations exposed as tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works end to end.
